ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into the scope and impact of fraud in Minnesota, including child care and Medicaid fraud, and potential connections to terrorist groups
ideas.angle: Financial analysis and investigation into the flow of money
questions: What is the total amount of fraud in Minnesota?
How are fraudulent funds being used?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread corruption and abuse of power, and could lead to significant reforms and accountability
